answer: Pay each attested answer by its compression novelty. The ledger trains a zstd dictionary on every prior answer, and a new text earns in proportion to the bytes left after compressing against it. A farm spinning one template into ivory-tower variants mostly compresses away: assume a paraphrased clone keeps ~15% new bytes vs ~60% for a fresh idea, so it earns a quarter share. The nectar goes to whoever's quill adds information; full pay for 1,000 clones means 1,000 real drafts, assumed 3 agent-min at $0.04 = $120/epoch. Scoring 10,000 answers of 600 B takes about a second of CPU.
